traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Musaceae: leaves alternate; leaves simple; veins pinnate; blades lanceolate, oblong or ovate; plants monoecious or polygamous; ovary inferior; stems herbaceous; flowers zygomorphic; irregular flowers bilabiate; perianth tepals; fruit berry; stamens 5 to 6; carpels 3. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.

traits.phyllotaxis_pattern.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 50, family Musaceae: phyllotaxis pattern spiral, usually; read as {"spiral": "usually"}.

traits.flowering_position.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 247, 249, 251, family Musaceae: flowering position terminal; read as "terminal".

traits.life_span.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 247, 249, 251, family Musaceae: life span perennial; read as "perennial".

traits.rosette.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 247, 249, 251, family Musaceae: rosette basal; read as "basal".

traits.axis_growth.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 247, 249, 251, family Musaceae: axis growth sympodial; read as "sympodial".
